caseName: Buck v. New Jersey ex rel. State Highway Commissioner

attorneys: James T. Dowd for appellants., Arthur J. Sills, Attorney General of New Jersey, and Elias Abelson and Edward D. McKirdy, Deputy Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Cukiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
